# UI Functional Groups Analysis

## Screenshot Context
- **Screen/Page**: Projects / Test project / List
- **Domain Context**: Project management and issue tracking (Jira Software)

---

## Level 1: Layout Zones

### Global Navigation Bar
- **Visible Elements**: Jira logo, "Your work" dropdown, "Projects" dropdown, "Filters" dropdown, "Dashboards" dropdown, "Plans" dropdown, "Apps" dropdown, "Create" button, Search input, "Premium trial" button, "Ask Rovo" button, Notification icon, Help icon, Settings icon, User Profile icon.
- **Observable Function**: Provides global access to system-wide entities, search, and administrative settings.
- **Location**: Top horizontal bar spanning the width of the browser.

### Sidebar Navigation
- **Visible Elements**: "For you", "Recent", "Starred", "Projects" (with "Test project" and "My Kanban Project"), "Filters" (with "My open work items", "Reported by me", etc.), "Dashboards", "Confluence".
- **Observable Function**: Enables switching between different views, projects, and filtered lists of work items.
- **Location**: Left-hand vertical panel.

### Project Header & View Selector
- **Visible Elements**: Project icon (yellow emoji), "Test project" title, Breadcrumbs ("Projects"), Share icon, Star icon, Fullscreen icon, View tabs ("Summary", "Timeline", "Board", "Calendar", "List", "Forms", "Goals", "All work", "Code", "Archived work items", "Pages", "Shortcuts").
- **Observable Function**: Identifies the current project context and allows the user to toggle between different data visualizations/modules.
- **Location**: Top of the main content area, below the global navigation.

### Main Content Area (Data Grid)
- **Visible Elements**: Search list input, "Filter" dropdown, "Group" dropdown, View settings icons, and a multi-column table containing issue data.
- **Observable Function**: Displays the primary dataset (issues/tasks) in a structured list format for viewing and editing.
- **Location**: Center-right, occupying the majority of the screen real estate.

---

## Level 2: Functional Groups

### List Control Toolbar
- **UI Elements**: "Search list" text input with magnifying glass, "Filter" dropdown button, "Group" dropdown button, "View settings" (horizontal lines icon), "Bulk change" (three dots icon).
- **Observable Pattern**: A horizontal row of interactive controls located directly above the data table.
- **User Interaction**: Allows users to narrow down, organize, or modify the display parameters of the list below.
- **Context**: Acts as the interface between the raw data and the user's specific viewing requirements.

### Issue Data Grid (Table)
- **UI Elements**: 
    - **Headers**: Checkbox (select all), "Type", "Key", "Summary", "Status", "Comments", "Assignee", "Due date", "Labels", "Created", "+" (add column).
    - **Row Data**: Issue icons (lightning bolts, checkboxes), Keys (e.g., "PTP-3623"), Summaries (e.g., "Time Tracking"), Status badges ("TO DO"), "Add comment" buttons, Date pickers ("13 Oct 2025").
- **Observable Pattern**: A structured grid with fixed headers and repeating rows of data fields.
- **User Interaction**: Enables reading issue details, clicking "Key" links for drill-down, and inline editing (e.g., clicking "Add comment" or the date field).
- **Context**: The primary workspace for managing individual tasks within the "Test project".

### Inline Creation Row
- **UI Elements**: "+ Create" text with a plus icon.
- **Observable Pattern**: A single interactive row located at the very bottom of the data grid.
- **User Interaction**: Provides a quick-entry point to add a new record directly to the bottom of the current list.
- **Context**: Simplifies the data entry workflow by keeping the "Create" action in line with the data being viewed.

### Filter Sidebar Group
- **UI Elements**: "Default filters" header, list items including "My open work items", "Reported by me", "All work items", "Open work items", "Done work items", "Viewed recently", "Created recently", "Resolved recently", "Updated recently", and "View all filters" link.
- **Observable Pattern**: A vertically stacked list of text links under a common category header.
- **User Interaction**: Allows for one-click execution of complex queries to update the Main Content Area.
- **Context**: Provides quick access to common segments of the project's data.
